definitions.explanation: Describes competition, conflict, or struggle that is extremely intense and unrelenting. Conveys a sense of burning intensity.

examples.japanese: {熾烈|しれつ}な⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦レギュラー→レギュラー：11396_regyuraa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦を{巡|めぐ}って→を巡って：27595_womegutte⟧{熾烈|しれつ}な⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧。
examples.english: A fierce battle unfolded over the regular starting position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{熾烈|しれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}め→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧、⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Technological development among companies has become extremely fierce, with new products being announced one after another.

notes:
USAGE:
{熾烈|しれつ} is primarily used to modify nouns describing competition, conflict, or struggle. It is a written/formal word rarely heard in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熾烈|しれつ}な⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧ (fierce competition)
- {熾烈|しれつ}な⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧ (fierce battle)
- {熾烈|しれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ (to become extremely fierce)
- {熾烈|しれつ}な⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧ (intense rivalry)

ETYMOLOGY:
The kanji {熾|し} means "blazing" and {烈|れつ} means "intense," together conveying the image of a raging fire. This etymology reflects the word's sense of burning, unrelenting intensity.
